parallels.note: The children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities with their pasture lands.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: The children of Israel gave to the Levites out of their inheritance, according to the commandment of Yahweh, these cities with their pasture lands.
translations.bsb: So by the command of the LORD, the Israelites gave the Levites these cities and their pasturelands out of their own inheritance:
translations.kjv: And the children of Israel gave unto the Levites out of their inheritance, at the commandment of the LORD, these cities and their suburbs.
translations.asv: And the children of Israel gave unto the Levites out of their inheritance, according to the commandment of Jehovah, these cities with their suburbs.
